remarks: A cottage charmer does exist when you are looking for one! This recently renovated 1BR freestanding home boasts new flooring throughout , new inside & outside lighting, LR/fireplace, large front screened porch, updated kitchen and bath w/skylight. There is even a washer/dryer with some basement storage! Gas heat & gas cooking with a recently installed efficient gas furnace. Rear private patio w/ beautiful rock outcroppings in the private rear yard and situated on 1.5 acres is the perfect site for relaxing/meditating! Located in lower North Stamford, just minutes to Merritt Parkway, shopping, restaurants and downtown Stamford activities. Off street parking. No smokers! Owner takes care of landscaping & snowplowing. A rare find!
